title: Correlation between vitamin D blood levels and implant success: a prospective cohort study
html: Background Vitamin D is a fat-soluble hormone that can be produced in the skin by Ultra-Violet (UV) light exposure or acquired through diet. Vitamin D is currently of relevance to dentists placing dental implants because it plays a role in bone metabolism and controls the immune system. There is some evidence that the osseointegration process of dental implants is favorably correlated with the proper concentration of this prohormone.
